headline: New Zealand Sharemarket Faces Pressure Following Wall Street Tech Rout
summary: The NZX index came under downward pressure after reaching a record high, tracking overnight sharp declines across major US technology equities.
why: The NZX 50 index tracks leading equities listed in New Zealand and is sensitive to international equity market sentiment.

impacts.name: S&P/NZX 50 Index
impacts.why: Spillover weakness from global tech indices halted momentum after New Zealand's equity benchmark hit record peaks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Negative sentiment spilling over from the US tech stock liquidation eroded domestic equity gains.
